key_insight: A gate-level NV-QWOA implementation amplifies optimal and near-optimal solutions to the Closest String problem without instance-specific parameter optimization.
engineering_relevance: The automated circuit workflow and analytical resource estimates provide a basis for quantum hardware experiments and classical benchmarking.
method: Encode candidate strings and evaluate their maximum Hamming distance to the reference strings.
Apply non-variational quantum-walk optimization using a problem-size-dependent phase parameter to mitigate excessive phase wrapping.
Compile into one- and two-qubit gates, with O(nm log k) qubits and O(pm log² n + pn log n) circuit depth.
evidence_signal: Across all simulated problem sizes, the algorithm consistently amplified optimal and near-optimal candidates.
watch_item: Simulation-based amplification does not establish practical quantum advantage; hardware performance and comparisons with classical algorithms remain to be evaluated.
paper_title: Designing Quantum Solutions to the Closest String Problem with the Non-Variational QWOA
